draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Nuvem! Once a village on the outskirts of Margao, it's now a town of its own on National Highway 17, about 5 km from Margao. Football and Konkani tiatrs, the local musical plays, are what people here love most.
draft.hungryLine: Margao's huge covered food market is just 5 km away, a great place to see what Salcete eats.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Check out Ashvek Vintage World for its old Mercedes, Morris and Volkswagen cars, then head to Majorda, a village famous for its beaches.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Make your way to Majorda's beaches, a short ride from here.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Nuvem once had a go-kart track up on the hill top.

tips.title: Catch a tiatr.
tips.body: Konkani tiatrs are hugely popular here, so look out for a show while you're around.

tips.title: Use the highway.
tips.body: Nuvem sits on NH17, 5 km from Margao, 24 km from Vasco da Gama and 29 km from Panjim.

story.title: Margao's outskirts
story.body: Nuvem began as a village on the edge of Margao. Its neighbours are Verna, Majorda and Seraulim.

story.title: A college town
story.body: Nuvem became home to Carmel College for Women and IAM Institute of Hotel Management. The Verna complex of Agnel institutions sits nearby.

story.title: A census town
story.body: By the 2011 census Nuvem had grown to 9,288 people. It's now a census town in South Goa.

story.title: Football and theatre
story.body: Football is the top sport here and tiatrs pack the crowds in. New hobbies keep turning up too, like a paintball-style game called MILSIM GOA.
